rule:
Every slab must have a thickness between 100 mm and 1000 mm inclusive.

Slab thickness is stored under different names depending on the authoring tool: a base-quantity depth, a dimension property, or a vendor-specific property set. A slab with no recorded thickness cannot be judged: label it ALERT, and do NOT report it as a violation.

Report the GlobalId of every element (modelled as IfcSlab) that does NOT satisfy this requirement.
notes: Version 2: 100 PASS, 12 ALERT, 0 FAIL. Property-based coverage/missing-data/false-positive control, not a violation-recall benchmark. Legacy version remains unchanged.

reference.status: evidence-backed project adjudication; not expert regulatory certification
reference.policy: Recorded total/monolithic thickness within 100-1000 mm with 0.5 mm numerical tolerance; missing recorded thickness is ALERT. No geometry substitution.
reference.limitations: Two agreeing properties may originate from the same authoring tool and are not independent expert judgements. Conflicting base-depth interpretation is specific to the audited mall export. Zero FAIL labels means violation recall cannot be evaluated.
